Iron Boy (2026)

Rating: PG
Runtime: 89 mins
Theater Date: January 22, 2027
Genre: Animation

Director: Louis Clichy

Cast: Gary Clichy, Rod Paradot, Dimitri Colas, Aurélie Vassort, Brune Moulin, Alexandre Astier, Jean-Pascal Zadi

Distributor: Sony Pictures Classics

Synopsis: The film follows 11-year-old Christophe in rural France, as he tries to live up to his rigid and distant father on the family farm. But the young boy starts to lean over and collapse without warning — on the tractor, at school, at dinner… A doctor finds the solution: Christophe must wear an iron corset to keep himself upright. Forced to reinvent his life away from the farm, Christophe discovers a new passion for music, meets a new friend, and follows her into his first mischief. But will any of this really fix what is out of balance?
